batch_path_misclassification.diagnosis: Batch submit exceptions were already recorded as provider failures in request_meta, but downstream normalization and rollup logic still interpreted empty raw artifact payloads as missing_expected_artifacts.
batch_path_misclassification.affected_scope: Any batch lane that fails before model output exists can collapse into artifact-absence noise; xAI batch submit was the evidenced live case.
batch_path_misclassification.fix: Added explicit request-failure classification and failure-stage tracking. normalize_step now records pre-model execution blockers separately and avoids labeling artifact absence as missing_expected_artifacts when the step never produced model output.

help_warning.diagnosis: The contract-map mismatch warning was reachable through import/print-only paths because step-contract resolution compiled the phase contract map with warnings enabled, and print-config wrote the map before exiting.
help_warning.fix: Made phase-contract-map warnings opt-in, defaulted get_step_contract to silent mode, and skipped phase-contract-map writes for print-only CLI paths.
